# Marian Košir's Development Resources

> > A collection of TypeScript and React development resources including boilerplates, style guides, and component libraries with focus on type safety and modern tooling.

This site showcases production-ready TypeScript projects and best practices, featuring tRPC frontend boilerplates, comprehensive style guides with ESLint/Prettier configurations, and React component libraries. The resources emphasize type-safe development patterns, code organization, and modern frontend tooling including Vitest, Playwright, and Storybook.

## Key Topics

- tRPC
- TypeScript
- React
- ESLint
- Prettier
- Type Safety
- Frontend Boilerplate
- Code Conventions
- Best Practices
- Storybook
- Vitest
- Playwright
- Code Organization
- Immutability
- Naming Conventions

## TypeScript Development Guides

- [TypeScript Style Guide](https://mkosir.github.io/typescript-style-guide): Comprehensive TypeScript conventions & best practices guide with ESLint/Prettier setup, covering type safety, immutability, and code organization patterns

## Frontend Boilerplates & Applications

- [tRPC Frontend Boilerplate - Home](https://mkosir.github.io/trpc-fe-boilerplate-next): Main homepage for tRPC Frontend Boilerplate with Next.js, featuring database seeding functionality and type-safe API integration
- [tRPC Frontend Boilerplate - Users](https://mkosir.github.io/trpc-fe-boilerplate-next/users): Users management page demonstrating tRPC implementation patterns in a full-stack TypeScript application

## Component Libraries & Documentation

- [React Parallax Tilt - Storybook](https://mkosir.github.io/react-parallax-tilt/iframe.html): Interactive Storybook component preview for react-parallax-tilt library showcasing React component documentation and testing
